existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Actual costs of searching for and retrieving data
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When copies or electronic transmittal are requested, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of searching for and retrieving the data, including employee time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks for copies or electronic transmittal.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost (search + retrieval + employee time)
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If a person requests copies or electronic transmittal of the data to the person, the responsible authority may require the requesting person to pay the actual costs of searching for and retrieving government data, including the cost of employee time.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Constraint is 'actual costs' as a recovery ceiling; the city sets the operative rate/basis under it. Search/retrieval cost is NOT chargeable on the 100-or-fewer-page standard-copy path (see MN-0009).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: 25-cent-per-page cap for 100 or fewer standard pages
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For requests of 100 or fewer black-and-white letter/legal-size paper copies, actual costs may not be used; the entity may charge no more than 25 cents per page copied.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for 100 or fewer black-and-white, letter or legal size paper copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If 100 or fewer pages of black and white, letter or legal size paper copies are requested, actual costs shall not be used, and instead, the responsible authority may charge no more than 25 cents for each page copied.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling of $0.25/page; city may charge less. Displaces the actual-cost basis on this small-request path.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Cost of making and certifying copies for a data subject
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When a data subject requests copies of data about themselves, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of making and certifying the copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Data subject requests copies of data about themselves.
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of making and certifying copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The responsible authority or designee may require the requesting person to pay the actual costs of making and certifying the copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Data-subject copy path (own data). Distinct from the general public-data copy fee; note this covers copies only, inspection is free (MN-0011).
